slides.headline: Why is Trump ignoring AI safety warnings?
Trump spoke this week on AI
slides.body: He said risks are exaggerated and the U.S. must win against China first.

slides.headline: He called safety concerns a distraction
slides.body: Critics say this removes guardrails on powerful systems that affect jobs and privacy.

slides.headline: Experts disagree on the trade-off
slides.body: Many researchers warn unchecked speed leads to errors, bias, and misuse at scale.

slides.headline: What this means for your phone
slides.body: Fewer rules may mean faster features but less protection for your data and choices.
